title: Miss Judy the Charter Boat
specs: Over 50 years of fishing experience in Coastal Savannah Georgia
Experienced and friendly captains and mates
blurb: Guests can book fishing charters for inshore, offshore, or Gulf Stream fishing. Trips are customized to customer needs and guided by experienced captains and mates. The company has over 50 years of experience and a state-of-the-art fleet.
highlights: Over 50 years of fishing experience in Coastal Savannah Georgia
Experienced and friendly captains and mates

quotes.text: More than fifty years ago my father started the very first professional fishing charter boat company in Coastal Savannah Georgia. The name may have changed to Miss Judy Charters, but the service is still as great! It’s hard to believe that I have been chartering trips for over forty years myself! I’m proud to say that our company is currently hosting its third generation of anglers. Many of the anglers we now take aboard, are the children or grandchildren! – Of people Daddy took so many years ago. As always, I’d like to thank all of you for your continued support.
